planets.name: Mercury
planets.fact: The smallest planet and closest to the Sun, with extreme temperature swings.

planets.name: Venus
planets.fact: The hottest planet due to a runaway greenhouse effect; it rotates backwards.

planets.name: Earth
planets.fact: The only known world to harbor life, with liquid water covering 71% of its surface.

planets.name: Mars
planets.fact: The Red Planet hosts the tallest volcano and largest canyon in the solar system.

planets.name: Jupiter
planets.fact: The largest planet; its Great Red Spot is a storm wider than Earth.

planets.name: Saturn
planets.fact: Famous for its spectacular ring system made of ice and rock.

planets.name: Uranus
planets.fact: An ice giant that rotates on its side, likely due to an ancient collision.

planets.name: Neptune
planets.fact: The windiest planet, with supersonic winds reaching 2,100 km/h.
